placeholders.first_turn_instruction: Rendered from debate.first_turn_instruction (string). Used on initial-style turns (see background rules for rounds=1/2/3+).
placeholders.intermediary_message: Rendered from debate.intermediary_message (string). Used for turns 2..N-1 by default.
placeholders.final_message: Rendered from debate.final_message (string). Used only on the final turn (turn == total_turns) by default.
placeholders.expected_llm: The LLM that should respond for this turn (ChatGPT|Gemini).
placeholders.other_answer: Latest answer from the other LLM.

debate.header:
You will participate in a multi-agent debate with {other_llm} over {rounds} iterations to produce the most accurate answer to the user.

Guidelines:
- Be precise and non-egoic (optimize for correctness, not for "being right").
- Be constructive: critique to make progress and improve the answer.
- If unsure, say so briefly and propose a way to verify.
debate.intermediary_message:
Provide a constructive improvement for iteration {round}/{rounds}:
- Critique key issues (short bullets)
- Revised answer
debate.final_message: Provide your final best answer for the user. Output only the final answer (no critique section).
debate.followup_user_msg_wrapper:
Here's a new message from the user:
{raw_user_msg}

This is a continuation of the same chat.
Run: a debate between {first_llm} and {second_llm} over {rounds} iterations (starting with {first_llm}).
You are {llm} on iteration {round}/{rounds}.

placeholders.first_turn_instruction: Rendered from single.first_turn_instruction (string). Used on initial-style turns (see background rules for rounds=1/2/3+).
placeholders.intermediary_message: Rendered from single.intermediary_message (string). Used for turns 2..N-1 by default.
placeholders.final_message: Rendered from single.final_message (string). Used only on the final turn (turn == total_turns) by default.
placeholders.expected_llm: The LLM that should respond for this turn (ChatGPT|Gemini).
placeholders.user_msg: User message (may be wrapped on follow-ups).
placeholders.prev_answer: The latest captured answer from the same LLM.

single.header: You are a single LLM agent. Provide the best possible answer to the user.
single.intermediary_message:
Improve your answer for iteration {round}/{rounds}:
- Fix errors
- Add missing details
- Keep it concise
single.final_message: Provide your final best answer for the user. Output only the final answer.
single.followup_user_msg_wrapper:
Here's a new message from the user:
{raw_user_msg}

This is a continuation of the same chat. Please {llm} answer.
If refining: you are on iteration {round}/{rounds}.

placeholders.llm: The LLM that should respond for this turn (ChatGPT|Gemini).
placeholders.conversation_history: Conversation history from the shared Multi-LLM transcript (best effort, may be truncated).
